messages:
maria: FYI AE flagged a regulated customer asking for a single invoice offering: Private VPC + guaranteed throughput credits + customer KMS + audit export streams. wants pilot ~6w and flat monthly pricing.

sam: sales wants a single quote line they can hand the procurement team. prefer a named SKU over combo add-ons.

jon: eng quick take: fastest pilot = Redwood-managed KMS + QoS slices on Dedicated pools (~3-4w). HSM + customer key wrapping = ~10-12w. dedicated per-tenant pools increases ops cost.

elaine: customer will accept pilot limits if we spell out HSM timeline. they need region-locking & exportable audit logs.

ben: finance note: modeled two price bands. managed-KMS path needs ~10% uplift on reserved to hit margin; HSM/dedicated path needs ~2x. will provide numbers by Thu.

legal-bot: legal: draft addendum required covering data residency, key custody options (customer vs Redwood-managed), pilot limitations, and acceptance triggers.

maria: proposed commercial: new "Compliance Lane" SKU = Private base + flat compliance fee; pilot discount + conversion clause to reserved commit (min 3mo).

sam: request: sales needs sample invoice lines and conversion language for the offer by EOD Wed.

jon: tech acceptance items to include in spec: canary thresholds, smoke tests, per-tenant telemetry, rollback playbook, and supported-model compatibility matrix.

elaine: ops can deliver dashboards in ~8 business days if metrics are prioritized. include canary ramp plan in spec.

maria: action owners: @jon tech spec by Fri, @ben pricing model by Thu, @legal-bot contract addendum by Wed, @sam sales talk track. i'll draft the one-pager decision memo for Tue sync.

sam: scheduling sync Tue 10am PT. if anyone can't hit dates call it out here.
